statement: Whenever min_abs_difference(nums, goal) returns a result r, r = min over all subsets S of {0,1,...,len(nums)-1} of |(sum of nums[i] for i in S) - goal|. The empty subset S is allowed and its sum is 0. This is the minimum possible absolute difference between goal and the sum of a subsequence of nums.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7; -10^9 <= goal <= 10^9.

statement: For every nums and goal satisfying the preconditions, min_abs_difference(nums, goal) returns a result r (an Ok result); it never fails, panics, overflows, or accesses out of bounds.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7; -10^9 <= goal <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever min_abs_difference(nums, goal) returns a result r, there exists a subset S of {0,1,...,len(nums)-1} (possibly empty) such that |(sum of nums[i] for i in S) - goal| = r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7; -10^9 <= goal <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever min_abs_difference(nums, goal) returns a result r, for every subset S of {0,1,...,len(nums)-1} (possibly empty), r <= |(sum of nums[i] for i in S) - goal|.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7; -10^9 <= goal <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever min_abs_difference(nums, goal) returns a result r, r = 0 if and only if there exists a subset S of {0,1,...,len(nums)-1} (possibly empty) such that the sum of nums[i] for i in S equals goal.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7; -10^9 <= goal <= 10^9.

statement: For every two goals g1 and g2 with -10^9 <= g1 <= 10^9 and -10^9 <= g2 <= 10^9, whenever min_abs_difference(nums, g1) returns r1 and min_abs_difference(nums, g2) returns r2, we have |r1 - r2| <= |g1 - g2|.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7.

statement: Define neg(nums) to be the slice of length len(nums) with neg(nums)[i] = -nums[i] for each i. Whenever min_abs_difference(nums, goal) returns r and min_abs_difference(neg(nums), -goal) returns r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7; -10^9 <= goal <= 10^9.

statement: Let total = sum of nums[i] for 0 <= i < len(nums). Whenever min_abs_difference(nums, goal) returns a result r, r = min over all subsets S of {0,1,...,len(nums)-1} of |(sum of nums[i] for i in S) - (total - goal)|; the empty subset is allowed.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7; -10^9 <= goal <= 10^9.

statement: Define rev(nums) to be the slice of length len(nums) with rev(nums)[i] = nums[len(nums)-1-i] for 0 <= i < len(nums). Whenever min_abs_difference(nums, goal) returns r and min_abs_difference(rev(nums), goal) returns r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7; -10^9 <= goal <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever min_abs_difference(nums, goal) returns a result r, if len(nums) = 1 then r = min(|goal|, |nums[0] - goal|).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7; -10^9 <= goal <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever min_abs_difference(nums, goal) returns a result r, if every element nums[i] is 0, then r = |goal|.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7; -10^9 <= goal <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever min_abs_difference(nums, goal) returns a result r, if every nums[i] >= 0 and goal >= total, where total = sum of nums[i] for 0 <= i < len(nums), then r = goal - total.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7; -10^9 <= goal <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever min_abs_difference(nums, goal) returns a result r, if every nums[i] >= 0 and goal <= 0, then r = -goal.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7; -10^9 <= goal <= 10^9.

statement: For any permutation p of {0,1,...,len(nums)-1}, define perm(nums) by perm(nums)[i] = nums[p(i)] for 0 <= i < len(nums). Whenever min_abs_difference(nums, goal) returns r and min_abs_difference(perm(nums), goal) returns r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7; -10^9 <= goal <= 10^9.

statement: Let P be the sum of all positive nums[i], and let N be the sum of all negative nums[i] (so N <= 0). Whenever min_abs_difference(nums, goal) returns a result r, if goal >= P then r = goal - P, and if goal <= N then r = N - goal.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7; -10^9 <= goal <= 10^9.

statement: For any index k with 0 <= k < len(nums) and nums[k] = 0, if len(nums) > 1 let nums' be the slice obtained by deleting index k. Whenever min_abs_difference(nums, goal) returns r and min_abs_difference(nums', goal) returns r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 40; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^7 <= nums[i] <= 10^7; -10^9 <= goal <= 10^9.
